integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from Pauli algebra, sector decomposition, Taylor expansion, and BCH orthogonality. The numerical checker is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Existence/minimality result for nonredundant Pauli decompositions; no genericity or physical-locality claim.
Does not classify all four-term cancellations or address randomized, repeated-factor, or negative-time formulas.
Residual risk remains from differently phrased abstract operator-splitting literature.
title: Four Pauli terms are minimally sufficient for ordering-induced second-order Lie–Trotter accuracy
